title: 2º cozinheiro - 1º turno
description:
Confira a oportunidade para 2º cozinheiro - 1º turno em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

O 2°Cozinheiro(a) apoia a preparação de alimentos e a manutenção da limpeza e organização do ambiente de trabalho. Entre suas responsabilidades estão lavar, descascar e cortar ingredientes, auxiliar na cocção e montagem dos pratos, manter o buffet ou refeitório abastecido e higienizado, além de cuidar da limpeza de utensílios, equipamentos e áreas de preparo. Também deve seguir as normas de segurança e higiene, utilizar EPIs adequadamente e zelar pela qualidade dos serviços, contribuindo para a satisfação dos clientes e o bom funcionamento da cozinha.     Auxilia na preparação de alimentos, realizando tarefas simples como lavar, descascar, fatiar e cortar ingredientes conforme orientações da Cozinheira(o).   Lava ou higieniza verduras, descasca legumes, fatia ou corta carnes, sempre zelando pela qualidade e agilidade do processo, visando a satisfação dos clientes.   Utiliza utensílios e equipamentos de cozinha, como talheres, panelas, forno e fogão, conforme necessário para a execução das tarefas.   Mantém-se atenta à reposição do buffet ou refeitório, garantindo que os alimentos estejam sempre disponíveis e adequadamente apresentados.   Realiza a limpeza do local de trabalho, incluindo pratos, talheres, panelas, mesas, balcões, cubas e maquinário (fogão, forno, geladeira, máquina de suco, entre outros) utilizando materiais e utensílios apropriados, como detergentes neutro, desengordurante e desencrustante, Cloro, vassouras, esponjas e escovas.   Realiza a remoção de lixo e lavagem do piso conforme necessário.   Realiza uma faxina mais intensa semanalmente, incluindo o piso, janelas, azulejos, geladeira, forno, fogão, armários, prateleiras e dispensa, garantindo a adequada apresentação e limpeza do local.   Observa os aspectos de segurança no manuseio de utensílios e equipamentos para evitar acidentes e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro.   Segue os procedimentos específicos adquiridos em treinamentos para o uso de equipamentos e métodos de trabalho.   Utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) quando necessário e garantir que todas as práticas de segurança sejam seguidas

Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.   Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial: Residir em Campinas  Ensino médio completo.   Conhecimento básico em Excel (manipulação de planilhas, preenchimento de controles e organização de informações).   Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de interagir com clientes internos e externos.   Organização, senso de responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes.   Perfil colaborativo, com disposição para aprender e se desenvolver em um ambiente dinâmico.  É diferencial:  Experiência prévia em áreas de atendimento ao cliente, suporte comercial, operações ou áreas administrativas.   Conhecimento ou familiaridade com ferramentas corporativas como SAP, SharePoint ou sistemas de chamados.   Conhecimentos intermediários em Excel e PowerPoint.   Noções de Power BI, Power Query ou interesse em análise de dados.  Interesse ou contato inicial com soluções de automação, inteligência artificial ou melhoria de processos.   Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Processos Gerenciais, Economia ou áreas correlatas.  Informações Complementares Esta é uma posição com forte exposição às áreas Comercial, Técnica e de Planejamento, oferecendo oportunidades reais de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional.   O(a) Assistente Comercial II terá contato direto com clientes internos e, em determinadas situações, com o cliente final.  A área valoriza profissionais com postura ética, foco em qualidade, melhoria contínua e orientação a resultados.   O cargo possibilita evolução de carreira conforme desempenho, engajamento e desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental.  O que te espera no dia a dia: Realizar atendimento aos clientes internos e externos, por meio de contato telefônico e canais digitais, esclarecendo dúvidas, registrando solicitações e conduzindo tratativas para solução das demandas apresentadas.  Tratar ocorrências relacionadas à base de clientes, incluindo solicitações administrativas e operacionais, como reagendamentos de contrato e ajustes cadastrais.  Realizar a abertura, acompanhamento e encerramento de chamados em sistemas internos, garantindo o correto fluxo das solicitações e cumprimento dos prazos acordados.  Apoiar as rotinas administrativas e operacionais da área de suporte comercial, incluindo organização de demandas, atualização de controles, registros em sistemas e envio de informações para acompanhamento das ocorrências.   Atuar de forma proativa na fidelização, retenção e conversão da base de clientes, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua da experiência do cliente e dos indicadores de qualidade e resultado.  Tratar casos pontuais direcionados pelas áreas técnicas e comerciais, realizando interface entre as áreas envolvidas e, quando necessário, contato direto com o cliente final.  Apoiar a área de Planejamento Comercial com análises simples, controles operacionais e utilização de ferramentas corporativas como SharePoint e SAP, com oportunidades de desenvolvimento em Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Power Query e soluções de IA.

Finalização: uso de perfumes e acessórios quando aplicável, garantindo que o pet saia limpo, cheiroso e bem-apresentado. Organização do ambiente: manter a limpeza e higienização do espaço de banho e tosa, organizar utensílios, zelar pela segurança dos equipamentos e pela manutenção do ambiente adequado aos animais. Gestão de agenda: acompanhar horários de atendimento, respeitar os agendamentos e colaborar com a equipe para fluxo organizado de clientes. Relacionamento: lidar com diferentes tipos de animais com paciência e carinho, transmitindo segurança; além de manter comunicação atenciosa e respeitosa com os tutores, tirando dúvidas e orientando sobre os cuidados após o banho.

title: Gerente de Compliance
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Gerente de Compliance em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

title: Ux designer pleno
description:
Empresa está contratando Ux designer pleno em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) UX/Product Designer Pleno II para atuar em uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia do Brasil, contribuindo diretamente para a construção e evolução de produtos digitais que geram impacto em escala. Buscamos uma pessoa com forte visão de produto, autonomia, pensamento analítico e capacidade de transformar desafios complexos em experiências intuitivas, eficientes e orientadas a resultados.           Responsabilidade e atribuições:  Conduzir o processo de Design end-to-end, desde a descoberta do problema até a validação da solução.  Realizar pesquisas com usuários, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e análises de comportamento.  Criar fluxos, wireframes, protótipos de baixa e alta fidelidade.  Facilitar workshops de discovery, ideação e cocriação.  Atuar simultaneamente em múltiplas squads e iniciativas de negócio.  Utilizar dados, métricas e insights para embasar decisões de produto e experiência.  Trabalhar em parceria com Product Managers, Tech Leads, Desenvolvedores e demais stakeholders.  Garantir consistência, qualidade e evolução contínua das experiências digitais.  Apoiar a implementação das soluções junto aos times de desenvolvimento.           Requisitos e qualificações:   Experiência em UX Design, Product Design ou áreas correlatas.  Vivência com Design Thinking, Arquitetura da Informação e Design de Interação.  Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade.  Domínio de ferramentas de prototipação e design de interfaces.  Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na definição de métodos, entregáveis e priorização de atividades.  Conhecimento em ambientes ágeis e trabalho com times multidisciplinares.  Excelente comunicação, organização e storytelling.  Inglês fluente. Diferenciais Espanhol fluente como terceira lingua  Experiência em produtos digitais complexos e ambientes enterprise.  Conhecimento em Design Systems.  Vivência em indústria, operações, automação ou tecnologia.  Experiência atuando em múltiplas squads simultaneamente.  Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao processo de Design. O que esperamos de você Perfil protagonista e orientado a resultados.  Mentalidade baseada em dados e evidências.  Facilidade para navegar em contextos complexos e multidisciplinares.  Curiosidade, senso crítico e aprendizado contínuo.  Capacidade de influenciar decisões através de uma visão estratégica de produto e experiência.           Informações adicionais:  Modelo de contratação: Cooperativa   Benefícios que oferecemos:  Plano de saúdePlano odontológicoWellhubDescanso remuneradoDay off no mês do aniversárioVale RefeiçãoModelo de contratação cooperativo  mais autonomia e parceria no dia a dia

title: Analista de suporte - sênior
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista de suporte - sênior em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da VagaSomos movidos por gente que acredita no que faz, que quer crescer junto e deixar sua marca em tudo o que entrega.Nosso dia a dia é dinâmico, colaborativo e cheio de aprendizados  e estamos sempre de portas abertas para quem quer somar. Se você busca um lugar onde suas ideias têm espaço e sua trajetória importa, vem com a gente. Estamos te esperando para criar o futuro juntos. VEM SER UM WELOVER!  O profissional atuará diretamente na administração e resolução de incidentes em ambientes virtualizados, servidores Windows e Linux, redes e segurança, garantindo a disponibilidade, desempenho e estabilidade dos serviços contratados. Procuramos um perfil técnico, analítico e orientado à excelência no atendimento, capaz de atuar em ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade. Requisitos e Qualificações          Sistemas Operacionais Experiência sólida em administração e suporte de: Windows Server; Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, Rocky Linux, Red Hat ou similares).Virtualização Experiência com plataformas de virtualização, tais como: VMware vSphere; Microsoft Hyper-V; Proxmox (desejável).Redes Conhecimentos avançados em: TCP/IP; VLANs; Switching e roteamento; DNS; DHCP; VPN; Balanceamento de carga; Troubleshooting de conectividade.Segurança Experiência na administração e suporte de firewalls corporativos. Conhecimentos em: NAT; VPN Site-to-Site e Client-to-Site; Políticas de acesso; IPS/IDS; Análise de logs e eventos de segurança.Ferramentas e Serviços Active Directory. GPO. Monitoramento de infraestrutura. Backup e recuperação de ambientes. Ferramentas de ITSM e gestão de chamados.  Diferenciais Experiência com firewalls da linha FortiGate da Fortinet. Certificações Fortinet (FCA, FCP, FCSS ou equivalentes). Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem como Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services ou Google Cloud. Conhecimentos em storage, SAN e tecnologias de backup corporativo. Experiência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e Data Centers. Conhecimentos em automação utilizando PowerShell, Bash ou Python. Certificações Microsoft, Linux, VMware ou Fortinet.  Responsabilidades e AtribuiçõesAtuar no suporte e sustentação de ambientes de infraestrutura de clientes. Realizar troubleshooting avançado em servidores Windows e Linux. Administrar e monitorar ambientes virtualizados. Atender incidentes, requisições e problemas relacionados à infraestrutura dos clientes, respeitando os SLAs estabelecidos. Executar atividades de análise de causa raiz (RCA) para incidentes recorrentes. Monitorar a saúde dos ambientes e atuar proativamente na prevenção de falhas. Apoiar processos de implantação, migração e atualização de ambientes de clientes. Administrar serviços de rede e conectividade entre ambientes on-premises, Data Center e nuvem. Realizar análise e suporte em firewalls, switches e APs. Documentar procedimentos, diagnósticos e soluções em base de conhecimento. Interagir com equipes internas, fabricantes e fornecedores para escalonamento e resolução de problemas complexos. Participar de escalas de plantão e atividades de suporte em regime 24x7, quando necessário.  Perfil Desejado Forte capacidade de diagnóstico e resolução de problemas. Excelente comunicação e relacionamento com clientes. Senso de prioridade e organização. Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão em ambientes críticos. Proatividade e foco na melhoria contínua dos serviços. Perfil colaborativo e orientado a resultados.  Formação Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.  Modelo de Trabalho Regime: CLT. Disponibilidade para participação em escalas de plantão e atendimento a incidentes críticos.  Objetivo da Função Garantir a estabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança dos ambientes de infraestrutura dos clientes hospedados no Data Center, atuando como referência técnica na resolução de incidentes, sustentação dos serviços e suporte especializado em plataformas virtualizadas, sistemas operacionais, redes e segurança. Benefícios Assistência Médica;  Assistência Odontológica;  Auxilio Creche;  Auxilio Educação (Certificações e Cursos);  Benefício Flexível  Conexa Saúde (plataforma de cuidado integrado);  Convênio Farmácia;  Day Off (Aniversariantes / Dia dos Pais e das Mães);  Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendida;  PLR Anual;  Programa de Indicação Interna;  Psicologia Viva (acompanhamento psicológico integrado);  Reembolso Van Escolar Filhos;  Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;  Wellhub (Gympass). description:

Requisitos e Qualificações·       Testes Manuais: Experiência sólida em testes manuais de sistemas WEB, desktop (legados) e sistemas de terceiros (LINX, Lyncros e similares). ·       Banco de Dados: Validação de dados via Oracle e SQL Server (domínio de comandos SELECT para consultas e análise de integridade). ·       SAP & Power BI: Testes em SAP (desktop) e validação de relatórios no Power BI (Web). ·       Testes de API: Experiência com testes de API utilizando Postman. ·       Gestão de Escopo: Uso de Jira e/ou Excel para controle de demandas, status report e gestão do escopo de testes. ·       Auditoria de Qualidade (Diferencial): Viés forte em auditoria  capacidade de validar evidências anexadas por analistas terceiros, aceites de usuário e documentação de RFC. ·       Documentação (Diferencial): Capacidade de estruturar roteiros de testes do zero, sem depender de templates pré-existentes. ·       Soft Skills Inegociáveis: Autonomia e resiliência para atuar em ambiente sem roteiros definidos; comunicação e persuasão para entrevistar usuários e levantar insumos; autoridade técnica e postura firme para cobrar correções, auditar entregas de consultorias terceiras e escalar bloqueios à Diretoria quando necessário.  Responsabilidades e Atribuições·       Auditoria de Qualidade: Validar as modificações realizadas pelo time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a qualidade das entregas, a conformidade das evidências e a integridade dos processos antes da homologação e entrada em produção. ·       Testes End-to-End: Executar testes manuais em múltiplos ambientes (WEB, desktop legado, SAP, APIs e integrações com sistemas de terceiros), assegurando a cobertura completa do escopo. ·       Validação de Dados: Realizar consultas em Oracle e SQL Server para verificar a integridade e a consistência dos dados impactados pelo projeto de adequação ao novo formato de CNPJ. ·       Gestão de Evidências: Estruturar e manter documentação de testes, roteiros e evidências de qualidade, garantindo rastreabilidade e conformidade dos processos de RFC. ·       Atuação Consultiva: Entrevistar analistas e usuários de negócio para levantamento de insumos de teste, comunicando riscos e bloqueios de forma clara para públicos técnicos e executivos. ·       Governança e Alinhamento: Participar das reuniões semanais de alinhamento (Weekly Sync) com os stakeholders da DPaschoal para acompanhamento, priorização de escopo e mitigação proativa de riscos.  Local de Trabalho   ·       Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido  3 dias presenciais por semana (impreterivelmente Terça, Quarta e Quinta-feira) nas instalações da DPaschoal em Campinas. Segundas e Sextas-feiras em regime remoto. ·       Jornada: Segunda a Sexta, das 09:00 às 18:00 (1h de intervalo). ·       Prazo: Contratação temporária  3 meses. ·       Feriados: Calendário oficial da cidade de Campinas/SP.

RESPONSABILIDADES  Assessorar e apoiar a Empresa na execução dos programas de Saúde e Segurança no Trabalho, controlando todas as obrigações e prazos legais da área, antecipando-se e reportando ao Gestor de sua área, a fim de assegurar o fiel cumprimento às disposições legais estabelecidas.  Promover inspeções rotineiras nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, atos e condições inseguras, tomando todas as providências necessárias, objetivando eliminar as situações de riscos.  Investigar os acidentes de trabalho e emitir as CATs, elaborando plano de ação para cada evento, participando de reuniões envolvendo a liderança da área onde ocorreu o acidente, visando permitir um ambiente de trabalho em condições adequadas de trabalho.  Pesquisar e analisar as causas de doenças ocupacionais e as condições ambientais em que ocorreram, tomando as providências exigidas em lei, a fim de evitar sua reincidência, bem como corrigir as condições insalubres, causadoras dessas doenças e/ou acidentes.  Acompanhar as NRs, verificando a obrigatoriedade da elaboração, implementando e verificando os vencimentos de prazos nelas estipulados, objetivando garantir o rigoroso cumprimento da Legislação vigente.  Preparar e ministrar programas de treinamento admissional e de prevenções e conscientização, visando o desenvolvimento de uma atitude preventiva nos colaboradores, quanto à segurança do trabalho.  Trabalhar em conjunto com área Administrativa nos assuntos pertinentes a sua área.  Elaborar os procedimentos pertinentes a sua área de atuação, tais como: plano de atendimento emergencial, trabalho em altura, permissão de trabalho, análise de risco do trabalho, entre outros, a fim de permitir uma melhor condição de segurança na Empresa.  Participar de reuniões sobre segurança do trabalho, fornecendo dados relativos ao assunto, apresentando sugestões e analisando a viabilidade de medidas de segurança propostas, objetivando aperfeiçoar o sistema existente.  Acompanhar e orientar as equipes de trabalho junto a auditorias e perícias trabalhistas, visando atender as necessidades da Empresa.  Executar as tarefas seguindo e respeitando as normas internas de Qualidade, Saúde, Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente, a fim de prevenir acidentes e possíveis falhas que possam ocasionar danos físicos e materiais.  Participar de treinamentos e seminários que propiciem o aprimoramento e o aperfeiçoamento do conhecimento no próprio setor de atuação ou cargo exercido, objetivando a melhoria contínua, bem como o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.  Solicitar a orientação do Superior imediato, quando do surgimento de dúvidas atinentes ao desenvolvimento das tarefas, contribuindo desta forma para a eficácia do trabalho.  Participar de reuniões com seu Superior imediato, tratando de assuntos correlatos ao setor, a fim de possibilitar a avaliação das práticas aplicadas e possibilitar melhor desempenho dos trabalhos.  Atender e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo, conforme orientação e solicitação de seu Superior imediato.

SOBRE NÓS A Brudovan Pneus foi fundada em 1973, na cidade de Campinas, pelo Sr. Domenico Micaroni e atualmente, a empresa é liderada por seus filhos, Domenico Micaroni Junior e Bruno Micaroni. Atuamos no comércio varejista e atacadista de peças, pneus e serviços, consolidando nossa presença em diferentes segmentos do mercado. Desde o início, com apenas uma loja de Auto Center, já contávamos com uma equipe de operações e de vendas altamente capacitada e atuávamos em um mercado em franca expansão. Esses fatores foram cruciais para nosso rápido crescimento e sucesso. Atualmente, possuímos quatro lojas na região de Campinas. Além disso, somos distribuidores exclusivos de pneus Michelin e óleo Castrol para motocicletas no estado de São Paulo. Expandimos nossas operações para outros estados estratégicos. Em Minas Gerais, o segundo maior mercado consumidor do Brasil, trabalhamos com marcas renomadas como Michelin, Levorin e Cobreq. No estado da Bahia, somos os distribuidores exclusivos da Motul. Nosso destaque no setor é evidente: somos o maior distribuidor de pneus Michelin do Brasil e estamos entre os três principais distribuidores da Levorin no país. Em nível internacional, figuramos entre os cinco maiores distribuidores Michelin 2R na América Latina. DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGAÉ responsável por desenvolver e manter relacionamento de negócios com os clientes e prospectar novos clientes na sua região de atuação. Atuação profissional de acordo com as diretrizaes organizações, assegurando um excelente atendimento aos clientes no ponto de vendas, fomentando as vendas dos produtos de maior interesse para a empresa, apresentando todo o portifólio, auxiliando os clientes nas tomadas de decisão quando a reposição do seu estoque, realizando ações de merchandising e eventos nos clientes. RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕESAtuar com a venda direta de motopeças, pneus, lubrificantes e acessórios para motos; Realizar visitas nos PDVs; Divulgar informações sobre novos fabricantes, produtos e promoções do portifólio; Realizar ações de Merchandising e Eventos nos Clientes. Desenvolver e manter relacionamento de negócios com os clientes e prospectar novos clientes na sua região de atuação.  REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕESEnsino médio completo CNH B válida Disponibilidade para viagens Experiência em vendas externas ou balcão de atendimento no segmento de motopeças, carros, pneus e lubrificantes Gostar de motociclismo e/ou ter familiaridade com o segmento. title: Especialista de Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade também para PCD♿
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista de Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade também para PCD♿ em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:     Quarterly package review    - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:    Student Support & Intervention    Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.     Collaboration    Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students’ progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.     Operational and Professional Conduct    Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide  .     Other duties, as assigned.    Working Conditions:    Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up      POSITION REQUIREMENTS    Minimum Education Required:     BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:    Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.    Specific Knowledge:    Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.    Other Skills (Desirable):    Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.    English level required:    C1 or above   Portuguese level required:    none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese     Child Safeguarding    Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.     EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion    EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Gestor de Negócios II | Diagnóstico IVD
description:

VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim!   Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos.    Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.    Atividades:   Buscamos um profissional com perfil estratégico e comercial para atuar na gestão e desenvolvimento de uma carteira regional de laboratórios clínicos, com foco no mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD). Será responsável por fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, identificar oportunidades de expansão, analisar mercado e concorrência, conduzir negociações e ampliar a participação da empresa nas contas existentes. A atuação será na região de Campinas e arredores, com rotina externa, visitas a clientes e interface com áreas internas para garantir execução, crescimento e geração de valor ao negócio.    Responsabilidades e atribuições:   • Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios;  • Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada;  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa;  • Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão;  • Aumentar market share nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais;  • Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação por conta e por território, com foco em metas, rentabilidade, potencial de crescimento e cobertura de mercado;  • Construir relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores das contas, incluindo áreas técnicas, administrativas, suprimentos e liderança dos laboratórios;  • Conduzir negociações comerciais, acompanhando propostas, condições comerciais, prazos, follow-ups e fechamento de oportunidades;  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vendas de ponta a ponta, desde a prospecção e qualificação até implantação, pós-venda e monitoramento de resultados;  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas como marketing, produto, aplicação, suporte e operações, assegurando alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e entrega ao cliente;  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, pipeline, conversão, participação de mercado e evolução das contas;  • Cumprir agenda de visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada.    Requisitos:   • Graduação completa;  • Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos;  • Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios;  • Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial;  • Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas;  • Domínio do Pacote Office;  • CNH categoria B;  • Disponibilidade para viagens;  • Residir em Campinas ou arredores;    Diferenciais   • Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos;  • Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais;  • Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado;  • Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

Conhecimento em metodologias de design instrucional, gestão de programas de talento ou engagement strategy.   Exposição a lideranças C-level em contextos de comunicação estratégica.    R$13.000 - R$16.000 a month   Nossos benefícios:   Plano de saúde e odontológico;   Vale alimentação e refeição;   Auxílio-creche;   Licença parental estendida;   Parceria com academias e profissionais de saúde e bem-estar via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;   Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);   Seguro de Vida;   Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University);   Clube de descontos;   Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem-estar;   Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável;   Parceria com plataformas de cursos online;   Plataforma para aprendizagem de idiomas;   E muitos outros    Mais detalhes sobre os nossos benefícios aqui:   Na CI&T, a inclusão começa no primeiro contato. title: DevOps Engineer - Remote
description:
Empresa está contratando DevOps Engineer - Remote em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Welcome to the realm of innovation as our next DevOps Engineer, where you'll be leading the charge in revolutionizing our DevOps initiatives. This role isn't just about managing infrastructure; it's about pushing boundaries and propelling us into the future. Get ready to architect cutting-edge solutions, mentor budding talents, and infuse innovation into our deployment processes. Armed with your expertise in automation, cloud services, and system administration, you'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our technological landscape. If you're passionate about driving change and leaving a lasting impact, this is the role for you.   What Will I Do?    What will my main tasks be?  You'll strategically develop and maintain advanced CI/CD pipelines, integrating the latest tools and techniques to streamline our deployment processes.    How will I contribute to the team?  Your role is pivotal in architecting and managing robust, scalable cloud infrastructure solutions, harnessing the power of cutting-edge cloud services to propel us forward.    Will I collaborate with other departments?  Absolutely! You'll work closely with product owners and client services to ensure our solutions resonate with our clients and meet their evolving needs.    What methodologies will I be using?  You'll embrace Agile methodologies, ensuring our projects are executed efficiently and effectively, driving innovation and continuous improvement.    Are You the Right Fit?    Do you have extensive experience with DevOps?  We're seeking candidates with over 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevOps realm, ready to take on the next challenge.    How familiar are you with coding best practices?  Proficiency in SOLID and clean coding principles, especially in the context of scalable solutions, is a must-have for this role.    What's your experience with code reviews and automated testing?  We're looking for candidates with extensive experience in conducting code reviews, writing automated tests, and implementing CI/CD pipelines, leveraging a variety of programming languages.    Can you demonstrate expertise in testing?  Strong expertise in both unit testing and integration testing is essential, with a focus on maintaining high code coverage to ensure the reliability of our software solutions.    How do you approach technical decision-making?  We're seeking someone who can make informed technical decisions and tailor approaches to suit each unique use case, driving innovation and efficiency.    What is your level of knowledge in IT infrastructure?  A solid understanding of IT infrastructure is crucial for this role, ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and secure.    Is your English proficiency at an advanced level?  Advanced proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in our global environment, fostering collaboration and understanding across teams.    Are you located in Argentina?  Candidates must reside in Argentina to be eligible for this position.    What Would Be a Plus?    Do you have experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or CircleCI?  Experience with these tools will give you a head start in tackling our DevOps challenges.    Are you well-versed in system security principles?  A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role.    Are you available to work on call when needed?  Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times.    What We Offer     Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere, shaping your ideal work environment.   Competitive Compensation: Choose between compensation options in USD or your local currency, tailored to your financial preferences.   Home Office Equipment: We provide the necessary tech to ensure you have a comfortable and efficient home workspace.   Flexible Work Schedule: Create a work schedule that aligns with your lifestyle, giving you the freedom to balance work and life.   Comprehensive Leave: Take advantage of paid parental leave, vacation time, and observed national holidays.   Cultural Diversity: Immerse yourself in a multicultural workplace that celebrates innovation and creativity.   Elite Teamwork: Collaborate with top industry professionals, learning and growing with the best.   Career Support: Benefit from a nurturing environment focused on mentorship, skill development, and varied growth opportunities.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:  The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators. One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data. OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable. REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:  Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning. title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.  Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.   Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.   Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.   Other duties, as assigned.  Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up   POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.   Other Skills (Desirable):  Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.  Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.  Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.   English level required:  C1 or above  Portuguese level required:  none for teachers instructing in English  C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

description:

Welcome to the realm of innovation as our next DevOps Engineer, where you'll be leading the charge in revolutionizing our DevOps initiatives. This role isn't just about managing infrastructure; it's about pushing boundaries and propelling us into the future. Get ready to architect cutting-edge solutions, mentor budding talents, and infuse innovation into our deployment processes. Armed with your expertise in automation, cloud services, and system administration, you'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our technological landscape. If you're passionate about driving change and leaving a lasting impact, this is the role for you. What Will I Do?  What will my main tasks be? You'll strategically develop and maintain advanced CI/CD pipelines, integrating the latest tools and techniques to streamline our deployment processes. How will I contribute to the team? Your role is pivotal in architecting and managing robust, scalable cloud infrastructure solutions, harnessing the power of cutting-edge cloud services to propel us forward. Will I collaborate with other departments? Absolutely! You'll work closely with product owners and client services to ensure our solutions resonate with our clients and meet their evolving needs. What methodologies will I be using? You'll embrace Agile methodologies, ensuring our projects are executed efficiently and effectively, driving innovation and continuous improvement. Are You the Right Fit?  Do you have extensive experience with DevOps? We're seeking candidates with over 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevOps realm, ready to take on the next challenge. How familiar are you with coding best practices? Proficiency in SOLID and clean coding principles, especially in the context of scalable solutions, is a must-have for this role. What's your experience with code reviews and automated testing? We're looking for candidates with extensive experience in conducting code reviews, writing automated tests, and implementing CI/CD pipelines, leveraging a variety of programming languages. Can you demonstrate expertise in testing? Strong expertise in both unit testing and integration testing is essential, with a focus on maintaining high code coverage to ensure the reliability of our software solutions. How do you approach technical decision-making? We're seeking someone who can make informed technical decisions and tailor approaches to suit each unique use case, driving innovation and efficiency. What is your level of knowledge in IT infrastructure? A solid understanding of IT infrastructure is crucial for this role, ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and secure. Is your English proficiency at an advanced level? Advanced proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in our global environment, fostering collaboration and understanding across teams. Are you located in Argentina? Candidates must reside in Argentina to be eligible for this position. What Would Be a Plus?  Do you have experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or CircleCI? Experience with these tools will give you a head start in tackling our DevOps challenges. Are you well-versed in system security principles? A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role. Are you available to work on call when needed? Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times. What We Offer  Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere, shaping your ideal work environment. Competitive Compensation: Choose between compensation options in USD or your local currency, tailored to your financial preferences. Home Office Equipment: We provide the necessary tech to ensure you have a comfortable and efficient home workspace. Flexible Work Schedule: Create a work schedule that aligns with your lifestyle, giving you the freedom to balance work and life. Comprehensive Leave: Take advantage of paid parental leave, vacation time, and observed national holidays. Cultural Diversity: Immerse yourself in a multicultural workplace that celebrates innovation and creativity. Elite Teamwork: Collaborate with top industry professionals, learning and growing with the best. Career Support: Benefit from a nurturing environment focused on mentorship, skill development, and varied growth opportunities.

description:

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?   At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas.   DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.   About The Job   The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues.   Working Tasks and Responsibilities   Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF's technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date. Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements. Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person. Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance. Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers' sites. Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation. Providing technical support to the sales department as needed. Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects. What You'll Bring   Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage. Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic. Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace. Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.   At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.   We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. title: Captain - airbus a320
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Captain - airbus a320 em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Description  Make the world your home.    It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.    Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.    What we offer    Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits: Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world The Role  As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.   Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bring  To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:   A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS  Additional Information    Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our " Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.    To learn more visit    Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Gerente de operações da mentoria
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Gerente de operações da mentoria em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre o Grupo Escalada    Somos um ecossistema com diversas soluções para empresas que desejam vender os seus produtos na internet ou que já vendem e querem aumentar os seus resultados. Nosso propósito é transformar o comércio digital no Brasil. Aqui, valorizamos inovação, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e pessoas com brilho nos olhos.      Representada por Dhiego Rosa – Instagram:@dhiegorosa e You Tube: dhiegorosa – contamos com mais de 700 mil seguidores nas redes sociais. Somos referência no universo das vendas online, fruto de uma experiência de mais de 13 anos no segmento, criando, vendendo empresas e consolidando marcas no mercado.      Nosso treinamento é reconhecido pela Amazon e pelo Mercado Livre, destacando-nos como uma das maiores empresas de mentorias e treinamentos para e-commerce da América Latina.     O que buscamos:    Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Operações da Mentoria para liderar e estruturar a operação da nossa principal linha de negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, padronização de processos, qualidade na entrega e desenvolvimento da equipe.    Procuramos um profissional com perfil estratégico e analítico, alta capacidade de gestão, autonomia para tomada de decisão e experiência em operações escaláveis, capaz de atuar diretamente na evolução da experiência dos mentorados e crescimento sustentável da área.      Responsabilidades: Liderar equipe de mentores, supervisores e suporte, acompanhando performance, desenvolvimento e estruturação do time; Garantir qualidade e consistência da operação de mentoria, assegurando padronização de processos, entregas e experiência do cliente; Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos operacionais, metodologias e processos internos; Acompanhar e analisar indicadores operacionais, como NPS, churn, engajamento, capacidade operacional e satisfação dos mentorados; Realizar gestão de crises, tratativas de casos críticos, conflitos e demandas sensíveis de clientes; Planejar capacidade operacional da equipe, onboarding e desenvolvimento de novos mentores; Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Comercial, RH, Financeiro, Marketing e Produto.   Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas; Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de operações, customer success, consultoria, educação executiva ou áreas correlatas; Experiência comprovada em estruturação de processos, padronização de entrega e gestão por indicadores em empresas de serviço continuado, como educação executiva, consultoria, mentoria, treinamento corporativo, Saa S B2 B ou customer success de alto contato; Experiência prévia com liderança de equipes operacionais de médio/grande porte; Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e acompanhamento de performance, incluindo OKRs, KPIs, dashboards gerenciais, CRM e plataformas de operação digital; Capacidade analítica para leitura de indicadores, tomada de decisão baseada em dados e implementação de melhorias contínuas; Capacidade demonstrável de atuar com autonomia, senso de dono e reporte de resultados, sem dependência de direcionamento constante; Perfil analítico, organizado, resiliente e com forte capacidade de liderança; Vivência em operações escaláveis e ambientes de crescimento acelerado.    Diferenciais: Experiência com infoprodutos, mentorias, educação online ou consultorias; Conhecimento em e-commerce, marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee) e comércio digital; Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento, scale-ups ou operações com ticket elevado; Vivência empreendedora ou passagem por empresas em fase de crescimento acelerado, com familiaridade em ambientes dinâmicos, alta autonomia e processos em estruturação; Compreensão da realidade do pequeno e médio empreendedor brasileiro, incluindo desafios relacionados à tributação, capital de giro, sazonalidade e gestão operacional.    Se você se identifica com a nossa missão de impactar o mercado de e-commerce e busca crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, queremos conhecer você!      Venha construir o futuro do comércio digital conosco no Grupo Escalada

description:

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?     At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.      DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.    About The Job    The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients.      This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.      Working Tasks and Responsibilities Supporting all post-sales activities. Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations. Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads. Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information. Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met. Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment. Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc. Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory. Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed. Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system. You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.    What You’ll Bring Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable. Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures. Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.    Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.      At DEIF, we are Winning Together!    We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.      We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. title: Client services assistant
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Client services assistant em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Client Services Assistant   Remote, Latin America   Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together.   We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team.   This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover.   You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real.   If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit.   What You'll Own -----------   Client Services Operations   This is the center of the role.   You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems.   You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared.   The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled.   Pipeline + Relationship Tracking   You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs.   You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client.   Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination   You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar.   That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full.   You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management.   This Role Is a Fit If You:   • Notice gaps and communicate them early   • Take ownership without needing to be chased   • Track details carefully and follow through completely   • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer   • Can support a busy team without adding noise   • Stay calm when priorities shift   • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful   This Role Is Not a Fit If You:   • Need detailed instructions for every task   • Wait to be told what to do next   • See problems but don't speak up   • Think "done" means "mostly handled"   • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented   Requirements   • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills   • Clear written and verbal English   • High ownership and follow-through   • Strong attention to detail   • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities   • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems   • Fast, stable internet connection   • Professional presence on video   Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools.   Work Setup   Remote, Latin America preferred   Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours   Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours)   How to Apply   We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through.   You'll submit:   • Your resume   • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you   • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work   We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes.   We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks.   If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Ai automation specialist
description:
